description: Find and rank schema.org entities from natural language, tolerating typos and alternative names. Returns bounded entity context with relationship IDs; use get_entity for full detail. The optional detail argument is summary (for each hit: id, type, name, url, the start of the description and the match score) or full (every property and relationship). A client on protocol 2026-07-28 or later gets summary unless it asks for full; an older client gets full unless it asks for summary.
name: fuzzy_find_and_traverse
